messages:
Sara: Quick sync — we need to confirm who owns the KMS envelope key rotation evidence for SOC2. Audit window due EOW.
Matt: I can own the rotation proof artifacts, but need a clear dataflow diagram and where audit logs live.
Sara: @Matt thanks. Dataflow: app -> redis cache -> inference-runtime signs with envelope key in KMS/HSM, master key in HSM; audit logs emitted to audit-ingest topic. I'll paste snippet.
Matt: Can you paste the snippet? Also who on eng-sre sets retention for audit logs?
Julia: Eng-SRE (me) owns retention config. For this project retention needs to be 2 years per compliance ask. I'll handle infra changes but need the log schema and sample messages.
Sara: Paste code and example: 

```
# sample log emitted by runtime
{
  "event":"kms_encrypt",
  "key_id":"hsm://env-key-2026-01",
  "user":"service:redwood-runtime",
  "trace_id":"abc123",
  "timestamp":"2026-03-15T14:20:00Z"
}
```

Sara: The audit-ingest topic is kafka://audit-prod, sample query to fetch recent events:

```
kafka-console-consumer --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --topic audit-ingest --from-beginning | jq '. | select(.event=="kms_encrypt") | .key_id, .timestamp'
```

Matt: OK that helps. @Julia can you confirm retention and whether CDC pipeline will copy to long-term S3?
Julia: Yes — I will add a mirror to s3://redwood-audit-archive with lifecycle to glacier after 90 days. Will post PR.
Omar: HSM vendor contract note — legal flagged that attestations are needed. Who is point-of-contact for vendor attestations?
Sara: @Omar liaison will be Elaine from Security; Elaine, can you own vendor attestation evidence? Need certs + attestation docs.
Elaine: I can. I'll collect HSM attestation and KMS key access matrix. ETA: Thursday.
Matt: For traceability, I'll add a small migration that stamps key_id and rotation_version into the audit payload. PR ETA Friday.
Devops-bot: new-pr #4321 opened by @matt: add-key-id-to-audit-payload
Sara: Great. Remaining blockers: (1) HSM attestation doc (Elaine), (2) infra mirror PR (Julia), (3) rotation artifacts (Matt).
Sara: Proposed milestone: evidence bundle ready by 2026-03-19 EOD. Is that feasible?
Julia: Yes, infra PR + mirror by 03/18, I think.
Elaine: Attestation done 03/18 morning.
Matt: PR + artifacts 03/19 AM, will ping for review.
Sara: OK set. I'll create a checklist in the compliance tracker and assign owners. Anything else?
Omar: Small ask — can we include a short blurb describing why envelope keys are used in our threat model for auditors?
Sara: I'll draft that and drop it into the tracker.
Elaine: FYI: vendor requires us to rotate the KEK every 12 months; note added to runbook.
Sara: Thanks all :thumbsup:
